Hi @{author}, thanks for wanting to contribute.

Pull requests here need a vouch from a maintainer first, and you're not on the list yet, so this pull request has been closed. Your branch is untouched.

To get vouched, open a [contribution proposal](https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}/issues/new?template=3-contribution-proposal.yml) that describes the problem and your proposed solution, along with a design discussion written with the HumanLayer RPI plugin. Once a maintainer vouches for you, reopen this pull request and comment `/recheck`.

The full steps are in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}/blob/{default_branch}/CONTRIBUTING.md#getting-vouched).
